title: GIVING TUESDAY - Chamber Gives Back - Convoy of Hope
seo_title: Giving Tuesday Volunteer Night at Convoy of Hope
description: This Giving Tuesday volunteer event at Convoy of Hope headquarters, sponsored by the Republic Area Chamber of Commerce, has volunteers count, sort, box and bag product for the Hands of Hope program. It is for youth ages 10-17; ages 10-12 must come with a parent or legal guardian, and children under 10 are not eligible. It runs Tuesday, December 1, 2026, from 6:30 PM to 8:30 PM at the Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center, One Convoy Drive, Springfield, MO.
venue: Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center
